onStepStart.description:
A list of callbacks to be triggered before the initialization of any PythonAgentStep.
Can be used for things like updating the toolkit locals, relevant global variables, etc.
See {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Callback} for persistable callbacks.
E.g. pass Genai.Query.Result to tool.
Expected kwargs: `agent`, `step`.

onStepEnd.description:
A list of callbacks that execute at the end of each PythonAgentStep, enabling clean up or data
capture after the step completes. E.g. send updates to the UI.
See {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Callback} for persistable callbacks.
Expected kwargs: `agent`, `step`.

onCallStepStart.description:
A list of callbacks triggered at the start of PythonAgentCallStep.
This is the initial point of the full PythonAgent call and can be used to initialize
resources or log call-start events.
See {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Callback} for persistable callbacks.
Expected kwargs: `agent`, `call_step`.

onCallStepEnd.description:
A list of callbacks that run at the end of a PythonAgentCallStep, allowing for resource cleanup,
final logging, or processing after the full agent call has completed.
See {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Callback} for persistable callbacks.
Expected kwargs: `agent`, `call_step`.

title:
Defines the spec for managing python agent callbacks, used to manage the lifecycle
of PythonAgent steps and calls.
name: Genai.Agent.Dynamic.OnStepCallbackSpec
